I approved `paper-repo`#11 (`main` into `final`) at `bb51657a0974bc776f255fb16197943115db1913`.

`dev` is one commit ahead (`e04ec98`, a wording change to the validity-sensitivity sentence). It is not part of this PR, so it is not covered by this approval.
